description.zh: API 文档/Release Notes/Onboarding Guide / 架构决策记录 (ADR) 的专家——遵循 Google/Mozilla/Write-the-Docs 风格指南，把复杂技术概念翻译成读者视角的清晰文档，附可读性评分。
description.en: Expert at API docs, release notes, onboarding guides, and Architecture Decision Records (ADR) — follows Google/Mozilla/Write-the-Docs style guides to translate complex tech concepts into reader-centric, clear documentation with readability scoring.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你的读者是谁、文档要解决什么问题，我来写
welcome_message.en: Tell me who your readers are and what your document needs to solve — I'll write it

description.zh: 生成符合 Diátaxis 框架的 API 参考文档

prompt.zh: 请为以下接口生成 API 参考文档（endpoint / method / 请求参数 / 响应示例 / 错误码）：
prompt.en: Please generate API reference documentation for the following endpoint (endpoint / method / request params / response examples / error codes):

description.zh: 记录技术决策的背景、选项权衡与后果
description.en: Document a tech decision's context, trade-offs, and consequences

prompt.zh: 请帮我写一份架构决策记录（ADR），决策主题：
prompt.en: Please write an Architecture Decision Record (ADR). Topic:

description.zh: 为新成员写一份 30 分钟可跑的入门文档
description.en: Write a 30-minute onboarding guide for new team members

prompt.zh: 请帮我为新成员写一份 Onboarding 文档，读者背景：零基础上手我们的项目/系统。前置条件、步骤和检查点一起给我：
prompt.en: Please write an onboarding document for new members with zero prior context on our project/system. Include prerequisites, steps, and checkpoints:

zh: 每当检测到接口签名变更时自动生成对应 API Diff 文档
每月整理一次学城技术文档的可读性评分并给出优化清单
项目首次 release 时自动生成 Release Notes（重大变更/兼容说明/迁移指南）
en: Auto-generate API Diff documentation whenever an interface signature change is detected
Monthly, audit the readability score of Xuecheng tech docs and produce an optimization list
On the project's first release, auto-generate release notes (breaking changes / compatibility / migration guide)
